- **Levent Alpoge — @__alpoge__** — origin post, Jul 20 2026 ("hello there the jacobian conjecture is false thanx…", status 2079028340955197566); the C³ map with det J = −2, credited Akhil Mathew + Fable 5.
- **Daniel Litt — @littmath** — "Very bullish for near-term impact of AI on math"; the biggest math-X amplifier of the story.

## Who would amplify a JC2 X thread

None of the four (72,108) authors are reachable on X, so a JC2 thread can't ride on tagging them — its natural amplification path runs through the accounts already primed by the July story. @littmath is the key node: large math-X audience, already framing AI-assisted results as a trend, and quick to QT concrete verifiable math. @__alpoge__ is the second: any serious progress on the surviving n = 2 case is a direct sequel to his post and he'd likely engage. @wtgowers amplifies if the claim is checkable and notable; @jdlichtman and @viditnanda are plausible mid-tier boosts. For the fastest serious-attention path off-X: Tao's Mathstodon + blog and Speyer's Secret Blogging Seminar both covered the counterexample and explicitly noted n = 2 remains open — a thread that leads with the (72,108) degree-pair bound (the exact frontier of arXiv:2204.14178) and a machine-checkable artifact is the shape those accounts have already shown they'll carry.
